card.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
card.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Base can't hear our ship's report. We were secretly sent to receive. I'm switching channels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only static. I need a forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's applause. Our real mission is entertaining base. I'm singing the forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now they've switched off. You've lost our audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this was rejection training. I'm handing you the microphone; refuse me a second verse.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 switches to receiving; A3 sings for alleged entertainment and A5 solicits refusal as rejection training.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs weather before watch and B4 reports disengagement, anchoring B in the ship's actual work.

heightening.evidence: B4 terminates the performance audience; A5 turns B into the next participant in a newly announced mission.
